population: the 57 selected full/no-checks/shell-only attempts in the same frozen 95; raw agent/tool-results referenced by native tool_finished events
selection: six longest unique canonical tool-result texts over 24576 UTF-8 bytes; descending byte count, then attempt_id and member
pairing: first lexically ordered archived provider request containing the original provider_call_id output; preserve exact original request separately
input: reconstruct the pre-fold tool output at that call_id using canonical_json(raw result); other original request fields unchanged
measurement: production fold_tool_output, EvidenceRef save/read and complete_rounds; byte counts for reconstructed unfolded versus newly projected input
provider_usage: original archived response belongs to the historical already-folded request; unfolded/projected provider tokens null, new paid requests zero
interpretation: offline reconstruction from authentic archived full outputs; sample protocol frozen before raw-output enumeration; earlier provider-input-only measurement retained
ledger_reconciliation: join all request artifacts against archived SQLite requests and pre_send tables; issued/request-purpose/local-rejection counts remain distinct
